Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_scrape, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    urls = ["https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2"]
    result = await batch_scrape(engine, urls)
    print(result.completed_count)
    print(result.failed_count)
    print(result.total_count)

asyncio.run(main())
```
